description:
In episode 5 of season 2 of The GitHub Podcast, Cassidy and Andrea welcome Sameen Karim, Senior Product Manager at GitHub, to discuss native stacked pull requests. Sameen shares how GitHub rebuilt legacy merge box systems, handled "ghost merges" across linked PR chains, and closed code owner security loopholes. Learn how engineering teams use stacks to break large features into smaller, reviewable PRs, and explore the open source gh-stack CLI.
